## Activity

During December 2019, East City Eye Clinic recorded 129 captures. Capture activity was maintained throughout the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic continued to provide a consistent service during the month. Recorded captures were processed through the usual pathway for image assessment and grading.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. A total of 2 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.6. These images could not be used for grading and should remain part of routine quality monitoring. The result provides a basis for continued review of capture technique and local operating arrangements, while indicating that most images were available for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 19 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This provides a measure of the time taken for images to move through the grading process and supports ongoing monitoring of service timeliness. The findings should be considered alongside the image-quality information and the operational context for December 2019.
